strategies.name: Pipelined Overlapped Four All-Reduces

Results in 4 all-reduce dispatches with 4-way internal pipelining, hiding local compute latency behind communication at the cost of increased dispatch metadata overhead.

strategies.name: Hierarchical Two-Level Reduction

Yields approximately 8-12 dispatches depending on hierarchy depth, trading flat communication for topology-aware bandwidth optimization.

strategies.name: Precomputed Coefficient All-Reduce
strategies.desc:
Recognize that the 4 nested scale/unscale/all-reduce stages apply a linear transformation, precompute the W×W coefficient matrix mapping input shards to output shards, then perform a single all-reduce on coefficient-weighted inputs.     S = 256; W = world_size
    a = [1.0 + 0.5*(r % 3) for r in range(W)]
    s = xm.all_reduce(xm.REDUCE_SUM, x)
    buf = s.clone()
    for r in range(W):

    s = xm.all_reduce(xm.REDUCE_SUM, buf)

    buf = s.clone()

    s = xm.all_reduce(xm.REDUCE_SUM, buf)
    for r in range(W):
